parsed.why: No facility ban; statutory gender-identity protections with documented enforcement (July 2026 civil-rights ruling), hate-crime enhancements, panic-defence repeal, 88% support. Only resident-facing gaps plus shared national border/document regime hold it back.

Low-risk tier; commission-enforced discrimination remedies, open X-marker IDs, sanctuary order shielding travellers' care, no facility ban. Weaknesses: protection rests on regulation not statute, no statewide LGBTQ hate-crime law.

Enforced birth-certificate restroom rule with trooper ID checks, statutory sex-marker ban, no gender-identity anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, prison care denial, worst Do Not Travel tier; killings near baseline.
Only state criminalising restroom use in private businesses — restaurants, hospitals, gas stations — up to a year's jail; universal exposure, litigation unresolved, enforcement undocumented.

Worst legal-risk tier; gender-identity protections repealed 2025 and localities barred from stronger ones, leaving no discrimination remedy; school-grounds restroom rule binds adult visitors, but no general restroom criminalisation.
